questions.name: Q1 Overall Satisfaction
questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the resolution of your case?
questions.explanation: Overall Experience. Rated 1-5, from Very Dissatisfied to Very Satisfied.

questions.name: Q2 Timeliness
questions.question: How would you rate the timeliness of our response and resolution?
questions.explanation: SLO / Timeliness Performance. Rated 1-5, from Very Slow to Very Fast.

questions.name: Q3 Communication
questions.question: How clearly did our team communicate updates throughout the incident?
questions.explanation: Communication Quality. Rated 1-5, from Very Unclear to Very Clear.

questions.name: Q4 Preventative Confidence
questions.question: How confident are you that steps have been taken to prevent this issue from recurring?
questions.explanation: RCA & Preventative Confidence. Rated 1-5, from Not Confident to Very Confident.

questions.name: Q5 Additional Comments
questions.question: Do you have any additional comments or suggestions for how we could improve?
questions.explanation: Voice of the Customer. Free-form response to capture feedback that scores alone cannot reveal.
